Opal ioctl payload formats and device state transitions and error handling beyond classifier and stubs.

findings.text: Fallback security filesystem helpers signal an unavailable device through error pointers for directory and file and symlink creation, while removal accepts its argument and leaves state unchanged.

Fallback BPF mediation unconditionally permits dispatch and map access and program checks and map creation and program loading and token creation and token command and capability queries, with map release and program release and token release performing no action.
Fallback perf mediation permits opening by type and allocation and reading and writing of events, with release doing nothing.
Fallback io_uring mediation permits credential override and polling setup and command handling and general use, and the initramfs populated hook performs no action.
Key read and write helpers for self encrypting drive authentication report that the operation is not supported.
Fallback Opal device helpers release without action, deny classifier matches, report success for control dispatch without effect, report no resume unlock, and provide a null device constructor.

Two boot PIN key names identify current and previous credentials, and the primary ioctl classifier accepts Opal management operations for save and lock and ownership and range and password and status and geometry and discovery families while rejecting other commands.
A storage security transfer callback receives opaque device context plus two protocol selectors and a data buffer and returns integer status, guarded by an include once macro.

Sequential buffer descriptor combines a character store pointer with capacity and current length; a declaration helper provides inline zeroed storage of chosen size, clearing resets length and terminates when capacity exists, and initialization binds caller storage then clears.

Overflow is defined as length beyond capacity; explicit marking moves length one past capacity, remaining space is zero when overflowed else capacity minus length, and observed usage is clamped to capacity.

String retrieval needs nonzero capacity and guarantees termination by writing at current length when space remains else at final slot; reservation warns on length far past capacity and only supplies a tail pointer when space remains; commit treats negative counts as overflow and otherwise advances without exceeding capacity; removal from empty state signals absence else shortens and yields the dropped byte value.

Fallback memory attribute helpers report success for read write and no execute changes and direct map invalidate and default and validity updates and machine check no spec set and clear and encrypted and decrypted transitions, page presence always reports present, and direct map capability always reports allowed.

Simple ring page node links list membership with a data page reference plus entry count and write offset and identifier; per CPU control tracks tail and reader and head and array base with metadata and page count and status and overrun count and write stamp and callback table, where status uses three numeric phases for unavailable and ready and writing.

Size shorthands denote byte counts from one byte through 128 tebibytes, covering powers of two and selected multiples in kilo and mega and giga and tera families, with smaller values as plain integers and larger values via wide constant wrapping.

Checksum handling uses four numbered modes from none through partial with a maximum offload level of three; data sizing aligns to cache line and derives overhead and headroom and maximum allocation from shared info footprint and page size, true size adds buffer and shared info footprints, and the fragment array limit is seventeen.

Bridge state records original protocol variant plus flags for foreign host and prerouting and destination translation and sabotage completion with fragment limit and input interface and output device and a union for address versus neighbor header; traffic control extension pairs an action miss versus chain union with maximum receive unit and zone plus post connection and miss flags.
Packet queue head starts with next and previous linkage matching packet layout, followed by queue length and a spin lock.
Queue head spin lock serializes mutation of doubly linked packet membership and queue length.
A distinguished sixteen bit all ones value marks segmentation by fragments.

Fragment descriptor pairs a memory reference with length and offset; helpers observe and assign and adjust length by signed deltas, high memory determines whether page iteration must loop, and a page iterator walks backing pages tracking offsets and per page span and copied progress.
Shared hardware timestamp storage unites a time value with opaque device data; transmit completion for express data path carries a pointer to a timestamp slot.

Transmit timestamping uses single bit flags for hardware request and software queue and driver progress and completion and device based hardware and scheduler and BPF extension, with combined masks for hardware and any software and any timestamp activity.
Zero copy state uses single bit flags for enable and shared fragments and pure zero copy and no orphan and managed references, with combined masks for fragment zero copy and all zero copy conditions.

Zero copy completion operations pair a completion callback with a link operation; buffer info combines operations pointer with reference count and flags, extended message form adds a union for descriptor versus identifier length and flags and byte count plus pinned memory accounting, reachable from base pointer via container lookup.

Shared packet info starts with flags and metadata length and fragment count and transmit flags plus segmentation size and segment count and fragment list, then a union for hardware stamps versus express metadata, followed by segmentation type and timestamp key and data reference count and a union for express fragment accounting versus destructor argument, ending with the fragment array.

Data reference counting reserves sixteen low bits for references with upper bits for other use; fast clone state has three values for unavailable and original and clone; segmentation offload types use single bit flags across transport and tunneling and checksum and fragment list families including fixed identifier variants.

Packet data addressing uses offsets when the offset mode macro is set else byte pointers; timestamp source has three values for realtime and monotonic and atomic time with a maximum marker at the last value.
External minimum helper referenced for clamped length computation.
